name: Xenobiology Wing
description: A clinical white corridor filled with the sounds of alien life forms doing alien things. Glass tanks contain creatures from across the cosmos: a blob that contemplates existence, a gas cloud with opinions, something with too many eyes and not enough spatial awareness. Bio-hazard symbols suggest caution. Weird smells emanate from various doors. A universal translator crackles with seventeen languages simultaneously. The floor is slightly sticky for reasons you don't want to know.
